Excellent! All 68 tests pass. I've added:

**src/numbering.js** (new file)
- `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)` — generates next invoice number in format INV-<year>-<counter>
  - Counter is 4 digits, zero-padded, starts at 0001
  - Restarts each year
  - Handles numbers in any order, ignores malformed entries

**src/invoices.js**
- `issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)` — assigns number and changes status to 'issued'
  - Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice isn't draft
  - Uses nextInvoiceNumber internally
  - Never mutates arguments

**Tests**
- 11 tests in test/numbering.test.js covering edge cases (multiple years, unsorted input, malformed entries, padding)
- 8 tests in test/invoices.test.js for issueInvoice (numbering, draft check, data preservation, immutability)

The numbering system correctly handles year transitions and gaps in sequences.
